decision: Use a bounded shell-free process run-owner to execute the already-separated dom0 and Coordinator evidence exporters, preserving their raw wire JSON for the authoritative challenge importer.

criteria.correctness: Preserves one challenge across two independently executed trust-domain exporters and passes their raw outputs to the existing wire-only importer without introducing a second readiness authority.
criteria.robustnessSecurity: Requires absolute executables, disables shell execution, bounds stdout and execution time, ignores stderr, and fails closed on spawn, timeout, non-zero exit, empty output, or output overflow.
criteria.latency: Runs the two exporters concurrently through the existing challenge driver; no extra protocol round trip is added.
criteria.resourceUse: Process-per-run only; bounded memory and time; no daemon, database, WAL, watcher, or persistent worker.
criteria.regressionRisk: Adds an orchestration boundary around existing exporters/importer rather than changing their schemas or MissionQueue semantics.
criteria.qa: Dedicated tests cover raw stdout preservation, absolute-command enforcement, timeout, output bounds, stderr non-reflection, and empty output rejection.

alternativesRejected.name: privileged-cross-domain-supervisor
alternativesRejected.reason: Collapses Qubes trust separation and adds persistent privileged lifecycle/IPC surface.

alternativesRejected.name: shell-command-driver
alternativesRejected.reason: Creates quoting/injection ambiguity and makes command provenance less auditable.

alternativesRejected.name: deployment-glue-only
alternativesRejected.reason: Leaves timeout, output-bound, stderr-reflection, and raw-wire preservation behavior outside repository QA.

alternativesRejected.name: persistent-replay-orchestration-db
alternativesRejected.reason: Adds state and corruption/recovery surface while the existing random one-run challenge already supplies freshness.

failuresLessons: Library callbacks are sufficient for unit composition but do not prove safe process execution at the real trust-domain boundary.
Exporter stderr must never become qualification evidence or user-visible diagnostics because it can contain host-specific or sensitive details.
Bounds must be enforced before the authoritative importer receives wire evidence; otherwise a valid schema can still become a resource-exhaustion path.
safety: Read-only defensive Qubes qualification only; no real financial operations, payment data, fraud workflow, or weakened security control.
